notes: Source of truth for the task DAG. Coordinator-owned: no task edits this file.
A task may change only paths matching its `owned` globs, plus `alwaysAllowed`. `coordinatorOwned` always wins.
`brief: null` means NOT DISPATCHABLE. Write docs/plan/briefs/<id>.md first (the /skein-brief skill), then set the path here.
Keep `owned` globs disjoint between tasks that run at the same time; `skein plan` prints overlaps.
money: true and pii: true make a cross-model review mandatory before merge. `done: true` is set by skein merge.

This repo is the team's sandbox for running several coordinators at once. CLI-00 is briefed and dispatchable; CLI-01 and CLI-02 are deliberately unbriefed so a new coordinator's first act is to brief one.
Tasks CLI-03..CLI-06 are SUGGESTED FEATURES for the team exercise (docs/plan/TRY-IT.md): pick one, brief it with your coordinator, build it. Edit or replace them freely.

modelPolicy.principle: The defects that matter are found by cross-model review, whichever model wrote the code. The reviewer is where model strength has the most leverage.
modelPolicy.structure: at most 6 agents on this repo across all coordinators (maxAgents in .skein/config.json); disjoint file ownership per brief; fix rounds resume the author session rather than starting a fresh agent

tasks.title: Test harness: typecheck and test scripts so the gate can judge work
tasks.notes: Phase 0. package.json has only build/dev/prepack, so .skein/config.json standard is `npm run build` until this merges; the coordinator then sets standard to typecheck + test. No product behaviour changes.

tasks.title: README: correct the repository and install instructions
tasks.notes: README.md still says `git clone .../mento-cli.git` and the package was renamed to @mento-protocol/cli in #6. Small, docs-only, no deps: a good first brief for a new coordinator. Check every command block against src/commands while there.

tasks.title: parseAmount rejects malformed amounts with a clear error
tasks.notes: src/lib/format.ts parseAmount splits on '.' and calls BigInt(): `1e3`, `abc`, `-1`, `1.2.3` and an empty string either throw a raw SyntaxError (handleError prints it verbatim) or silently produce a wrong bigint. Needs CLI-00's test runner. Pure module, no network: a good second brief.

tasks.title: `mento balances <address>`: stable and collateral balances for an address
tasks.notes: Suggested feature. New command under src/commands/, registered in src/index.ts (coordinator grants that line). Reads only: SDK token lists plus ERC-20 balanceOf via viem. Supports --json. No wallet, no key. Tests mock the SDK and the chain client.

tasks.title: `mento quote --all-routes`: compare every route for a pair, best first
tasks.notes: Suggested feature. src/commands/quote.ts today quotes one route; the SDK can enumerate routes for a pair. Show amountOut per route, best first, and keep the default single-route output unchanged. --json emits an array. Read-only.

tasks.title: `--output csv` for tokens, pools and routes
tasks.notes: Suggested feature. src/lib/format.ts `output()` renders a table or JSON; add csv with the same rows and headers (RFC 4180 quoting). Global option beside --json in src/index.ts. Pure formatting, unit-testable without the network.

tasks.title: Structured errors: `--json` failures emit one JSON object on stderr with a stable code
tasks.notes: Suggested feature. src/lib/errors.ts handleError prints prose and exits 1 for every class. With --json, emit {code, message, hint} on stderr, exit codes per class (2 usage, 3 network, 4 chain, 1 other). AGENTS.md P5: stdout stays exactly one JSON document.
